title: Finnish Train Pack [MTR4]
description: MTR4 pack containing some Finnish trains
body:
### This resource pack adds some Finnish trains to Minecraft Transit Railway 4

List of trains:
- Dm6 (same as Dm7 in the pack)
- Dm7 (closer in height to Dm6, but not exactly either, which is why these are bundled together)

#### note: you must jump to get in some of the trains
#### note 2: interior for Dm6/Dm7 will be added once MTR4 adds functional seats
